# Accessibility Statement

ZeroLabz is committed to ensuring our post-quantum bioscience telemetry and modeling tools are accessible to all researchers, regardless of physical or cognitive ability.

## Supported Environments
- The quantum-edge P2P WebGL visualizers support high-contrast modes and keyboard navigation.
- Core CLI tools and the proxy middleware are fully compatible with terminal screen readers.

## Reporting Issues
If you encounter any accessibility barriers within our interfaces, please report them to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
